subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should automatic Antigravity selection use context-specific semantics—reset-focused for menu reset presentation and maximum binding usage for highest-usage ranking—or must every automatic consumer select the same quota lane?
rationale: Both behaviors are defensible, and the choice changes existing user-visible automatic-mode output; repository history and current tests do not establish one permanent contract.

options.title: Confirm context-specific semantics
options.body: Keep reset presentation focused on the relevant reset while highest-usage ranking reflects the maximum binding quota, then document and test both contracts.

options.title: Use one shared lane everywhere
options.body: Require the menu bar and highest-usage Overview to resolve the same quota window, accepting that either reset relevance or maximum usage may be less accurate in one context.

recommendation.title: Confirm context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Keep reset presentation focused on the relevant reset while highest-usage ranking reflects the maximum binding quota, then document and test both contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history shows the strongest involvement in merging and evolving Antigravity quota presentation and ranking behavior.
